action_items: PRIMARY FIX (still not resolved): Continue button stays disabled because basicsMethods.formState.isValid never flips to true. The three fixes shipped by main agent are present in source but do not resolve the runtime symptom. Recommended next steps for main agent to try:

1) In CreateProjectWizard.tsx, replace `mode:'onChange'` with `mode:'all'` (or add `reValidateMode:'onChange'`) on both basicsMethods and detailsMethods. `mode:'onChange'` in RHF v7 sometimes needs `reValidateMode` to actually update isValid on every keystroke.

2) Change the gating from `basicsMethods.formState.isValid` to an explicit `await basicsMethods.trigger()` call inside `onButtonPress` — i.e., always render Continue as enabled and validate on click, showing per-field errors if any. This is the safer pattern for multi-step wizards with async zod resolvers.

3) Verify `draft.basics` initial value: it is `emptyBasics` with `name:'', sector:'', location:'', targetAmount:0, durationValue:12, durationUnit:'MONTHS'` (see /app/src/store/useProjectDraftStore.ts). useForm({defaultValues: draft.basics}) therefore starts with invalid name/sector/location/targetAmount. If RHF resolver v7 is being used with Controllers whose `value` is undefined at first render, isValid may stick at false even after onChangeText fires. Try `useForm({..., defaultValues: draft.basics, mode: 'all', shouldUnregister: false })`.

4) Add temporary debug: `useEffect(()=>{ console.log('BASICS isValid', basicsMethods.formState.isValid, 'errors', basicsMethods.formState.errors, 'values', basicsMethods.getValues()) })` — this will surface in the browser console and tell you EXACTLY which field(s) are keeping isValid false.
5) Consider dropping the double-bookkeeping: read basics values directly from the zustand draft store (which is already valid) instead of from RHF.formState.
After a real fix ships, RE-RUN full STEP 1..9 lifecycle. Nothing downstream could be verified this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: The RHF+RN-Web+zod-coerce-number combo has a known-fragile isValid computation. Prefer validating on-click via trigger() rather than gating the button via formState.isValid; this decouples the visual gate from the flaky RHF proxy subscription.
Duplicate bookkeeping between RHF form state (basicsMethods) and zustand draft store (via watch+debounced setBasics) is error-prone. Two sources of truth => this bug. Pick one.

Persisted draft resume Alert.alert('Resume draft?') is a no-op on RN-Web (Alert on web is a stub). So users who had a stale draft (e.g., from iteration_2 blocked attempts) silently resume with values on-screen but no way to 'Start fresh'. Add a web-friendly modal for this.

rca of the issue: Root cause (unchanged from iteration_2): basicsMethods.formState.isValid stays false even when every field in the RHF form holds a schema-valid value (verified via zustand draft store which is populated from methods.watch subscription). React fiber inspection on the Continue Pressable shows props.disabled === true, and DOM shows aria-disabled='true' + pointer-events:none — confirming the disabled comes from `!canProceedToNextStep()` returning true. Main agent's three fixes ARE present in source (verified by viewing /app/src/screens/projects/steps/CreateProjectStepBasics.tsx L91-95 shouldValidate:true, L35 methods.trigger(); /app/src/screens/projects/CreateProjectWizard.tsx L66 defaultValues:draft.basics) but they do NOT flip isValid to true at runtime. Likely deeper cause candidates: (a) useForm mode:'onChange' does not aggressively re-compute isValid across all fields when using zodResolver + z.coerce.number on the same form — a known RHF v7 sharp edge; (b) initial defaultValues use `emptyBasics` (name:'', sector:'', location:'', targetAmount:0) so trigger() at mount marks form invalid AND caches errors, and subsequent Controller.onChange calls update field values but do NOT re-run the full async resolver's error-reduce path that would clear stale errors; (c) FormInput's Controller passes `value={value}` where value can be a number for targetAmount/durationValue while the RN <input> expects a string, causing controlled/uncontrolled churn that resets validation. Recommended safest fix: DROP `disabled={!canProceedToNextStep()}` and instead call `const ok = await basicsMethods.trigger(); if (ok) goNext(); else showErrors();` inside `onButtonPress`, and always render Continue enabled. This is the standard multi-step wizard pattern and sidesteps the flaky isValid proxy entirely. Reproduction script and DOM chain evidence are archived in the test_reports folder.
